title: perform: request
description: Run one actor and record the run. Until actors are configured, the request names the runner, its options and the effect check itself; config replaces these. A request never carries a host path, a command line or a policy value.

options.description: The runner's own options, passed to it untouched. Absent means {}. An extension point: the runner's published options schema fills it, and without one only {} validates.

instructions.description: What the actor is asked to do. Absent means the empty string.

runnerOptions.title: The runner's options
runnerOptions.description: The default for the runnerOptions extension point: no options.
